# Contract: `InsertionModalBloc` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/`)

One screen-scoped bloc for the whole modal (same "one bloc per screen, flat sealed sub-states"
shape as `VaultBloc` — RF03 research.md R4), created fresh by `BlocProvider` every time
`showModalBottomSheet` opens the modal and disposed when it closes — which is what makes FR-002's
"reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" true without an explicit reset event.

```dart
sealed class InsertionModalState extends Equatable {}

class InsertionModalTexto extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoSaving extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final String message; }

class InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioRecording extends InsertionModalState { final Duration elapsed; }
class InsertionModalAudioSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }

class InsertionModalFotoCaptura extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }

sealed class InsertionModalEvent {}
class TabSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final CaptureTab tab; }
class TextDraftChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class SaveTextSubmitted extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class AudioTimerTicked extends InsertionModalEvent {}          // internal, drives `elapsed` only
class AudioStopRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoSourceSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final PhotoSource source; }
class RetryRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class ModalClosed extends InsertionModalEvent {}

enum CaptureTab { texto, audio, foto }
```

- **Initial state**: `const InsertionModalTexto(text: '')` — no `ModalOpened`/async-resolution
  event is needed (unlike `VaultBloc`'s `VaultOpened`, which has to await
  `DetermineVaultEntryUseCase` first); the Texto tab's default state is static and synchronous
  (FR-002).
- **`TabSelected(audio)`**: calls `AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission()`; `false` ->
  `InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied` (Edge Cases: explanatory message, no controls); `true` ->
  `AudioCaptureRepository.start()` -> `InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: Duration.zero)`, and
  starts a local 1-second ticker that dispatches `AudioTimerTicked` to advance `elapsed` (the
  waveform's own visual animation reads `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` directly, not
  through this bloc — contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).
- **`TabSelected(foto)`**: -> `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()` unconditionally (camera/gallery
  permission is requested per-button-tap by `image_picker` itself, not up front — Edge Cases'
  permission-denied message is shown by catching that attempt's resulting `null`/exception in
  `PhotoSourceSelected`'s handler, not by a pre-check here).
- **`TabSelected(texto)`**: -> `InsertionModalTexto(text: _textDraft)`, restoring whatever was
  typed before switching away (an ordinary tab-switch convenience, not itself FR-required, but
  consistent with FR-002 only mandating a reset on a *fresh modal open*, not on every tab
  revisit).
- **`TabSelected(<anything>)` while `InsertionModalAudioRecording`**: calls
  `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` before transitioning to the target tab's state (Edge Cases:
  switching tabs mid-recording discards it).
- **`SaveTextSubmitted`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalTextoSaving` — double-tap guard,
  Assumptions): `-> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)` then awaits `SaveTextEntryUseCase(text)`;
  `Right(entry)` closes the modal (the page listens for this via `BlocListener`, pops the sheet);
  `Left(failure)` -> `InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)`.
- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the
  ticker, calls `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` to get the file path (stored in the bloc-private
  `_pendingAudioPath`), emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving()`, then awaits
  `SaveAudioEntryUseCase(path)` and maps its three-way failure (data-model.md's transition table)
  to `InsertionModalAudioFailure` with the matching message, or closes the modal on success.
- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalFotoSaving`): calls
  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` -> stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`
  (cancelled); a path -> stores it in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoSaving()`, then
  awaits `SavePhotoEntryUseCase(path)`, same failure-mapping shape as audio.
- **`RetryRequested`**: re-dispatches the same saving branch against whichever of
  `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` is non-null for the tab the failure state belongs to — no
  re-recording, no re-picking (FR-009).
- **`ModalClosed`**: calls `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` if a recording is in flight; the
  bloc is then disposed by `BlocProvider` as the sheet closes — nothing further to do (FR-008).
- **What the page does, not the bloc**: on any transition into a "success" condition (handled as a
  one-shot side effect, not a state — see `save-usecases.md`), `InsertionModalPage` is the one that
  calls `Navigator.pop` to close the sheet (FR-011: "the modal closes and return[s] the user to
  Home/Chat with no other visible change"). The bloc's own state never needs a dedicated
  `InsertionModalSuccess` case precisely because there is nothing to render for it — the sheet is
  simply gone.

## Who depends on this

`InsertionModalPage` and its three tab widgets (`TextoTabView`, `AudioTabView`, `FotoTabView`) —
each renders only the sub-states relevant to its own tab via `state is InsertionModal<Tab>*`
pattern matching, the same exhaustive-`switch` convention `VaultBloc`/`VaultPage` already use. The
waveform widget additionally reads `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` via `get_it` directly
(the one sanctioned bypass of "always through the bloc," justified in
contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).

lines: - **FR-001**: The system MUST provide an Insertion Modal, opened by the "+" button on Home/Chat, shown as an overlay above Home/Chat (with a darkened scrim) without discarding or navigating away from Home/Chat's state underneath.

- **FR-002**: The Insertion Modal MUST present exactly three capture modes as tabs — "Texto", "Áudio", "Foto" — with the active tab visually distinguished, and MUST reset every tab to its initial, empty state each time the modal is freshly opened.
- **FR-003**: The "Texto" tab MUST provide a free multiline text field and a "Salvar" action that is unavailable while the field is empty.
-- **FR-004**: The "Áudio" tab MUST start real-time audio recording as soon as it becomes active, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running timer, matching the "Gravando" state.

+- **FR-004**: The "Áudio" tab MUST open on an idle state showing a round start control with the caption "Toque para gravar"; real-time audio recording MUST start only once the user taps that control, at which point a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running timer appear, matching the "Gravando" state.
- **FR-005**: The "Foto" tab MUST offer the user a choice between the device camera and the photo gallery to supply a single image, matching the "Captura" state.

- **FR-006**: Confirming Save on any modality MUST result in exactly one persisted journal entry, created through the entry-creation endpoint, carrying the content appropriate to that modality and the correct origin (`manual` for text, `audio` for audio, `photo` for photo) — never a chat message. This guarantee MUST hold even if the user triggers Save/stop/picker-confirm more than once in quick succession for the same capture (e.g., a double tap): the system MUST ignore any such trigger received while a save for that capture is already in flight, so at most one entry is ever created per confirmed capture.

- **FR-007**: For the audio and photo modalities, confirming Save MUST automatically produce the text content the entry requires — via on-device transcription for audio and backend text recognition for photo — before the entry is created, shown to the user only as a plain, generic loading indicator while it happens; this unit MUST NOT present a dedicated multi-state screen (distinct "processing", "transcribed"/"recognized", or "error" states with their own styling), an editable review step for the recognized text, or modality-specific retry affordances such as "Tentar novamente" or "Salvar só a foto" — those are reserved for a later unit.

# Contract: `InsertionModalBloc` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/`)

One screen-scoped bloc for the whole modal (same "one bloc per screen, flat sealed sub-states"
shape as `VaultBloc` — RF03 research.md R4), created fresh by `BlocProvider` every time
`showModalBottomSheet` opens the modal and disposed when it closes — which is what makes FR-002's
"reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" true without an explicit reset event.

```dart
sealed class InsertionModalState extends Equatable {}

class InsertionModalTexto extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoSaving extends InsertionModalState { final String text; }
class InsertionModalTextoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String text; final String message; }

class InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioRecording extends InsertionModalState { final Duration elapsed; }
class InsertionModalAudioSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalAudioFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }

class InsertionModalFotoCaptura extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoPermissionDenied extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoSaving extends InsertionModalState {}
class InsertionModalFotoFailure extends InsertionModalState { final String message; }

sealed class InsertionModalEvent {}
class TabSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final CaptureTab tab; }
class TextDraftChanged extends InsertionModalEvent { final String text; }
class SaveTextSubmitted extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class AudioTimerTicked extends InsertionModalEvent {}          // internal, drives `elapsed` only
class AudioStopRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class PhotoSourceSelected extends InsertionModalEvent { final PhotoSource source; }
class RetryRequested extends InsertionModalEvent {}
class ModalClosed extends InsertionModalEvent {}

enum CaptureTab { texto, audio, foto }
```

- **Initial state**: `const InsertionModalTexto(text: '')` — no `ModalOpened`/async-resolution
  event is needed (unlike `VaultBloc`'s `VaultOpened`, which has to await
  `DetermineVaultEntryUseCase` first); the Texto tab's default state is static and synchronous
  (FR-002).
- **`TabSelected(audio)`**: calls `AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission()`; `false` ->
  `InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied` (Edge Cases: explanatory message, no controls); `true` ->
  `AudioCaptureRepository.start()` -> `InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: Duration.zero)`, and
  starts a local 1-second ticker that dispatches `AudioTimerTicked` to advance `elapsed` (the
  waveform's own visual animation reads `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` directly, not
  through this bloc — contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).
- **`TabSelected(foto)`**: -> `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()` unconditionally (camera/gallery
  permission is requested per-button-tap by `image_picker` itself, not up front — Edge Cases'
  permission-denied message is shown by catching that attempt's resulting `null`/exception in
  `PhotoSourceSelected`'s handler, not by a pre-check here).
- **`TabSelected(texto)`**: -> `InsertionModalTexto(text: _textDraft)`, restoring whatever was
  typed before switching away (an ordinary tab-switch convenience, not itself FR-required, but
  consistent with FR-002 only mandating a reset on a *fresh modal open*, not on every tab
  revisit).
- **`TabSelected(<anything>)` while `InsertionModalAudioRecording`**: calls
  `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` before transitioning to the target tab's state (Edge Cases:
  switching tabs mid-recording discards it).
- **`SaveTextSubmitted`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalTextoSaving` — double-tap guard,
  Assumptions): `-> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)` then awaits `SaveTextEntryUseCase(text)`;
  `Right(entry)` closes the modal (the page listens for this via `BlocListener`, pops the sheet);
  `Left(failure)` -> `InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)`.
- **`AudioStopRequested`** (ignored unless `state is InsertionModalAudioRecording`): stops the
  ticker, calls `AudioCaptureRepository.stop()` to get the file path (stored in the bloc-private
  `_pendingAudioPath`), emits `InsertionModalAudioSaving()`, then awaits
  `SaveAudioEntryUseCase(path)` and maps its three-way failure (data-model.md's transition table)
  to `InsertionModalAudioFailure` with the matching message, or closes the modal on success.
- **`PhotoSourceSelected(source)`** (ignored if `state is InsertionModalFotoSaving`): calls
  `PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)`; `null` -> stays `InsertionModalFotoCaptura()`
  (cancelled); a path -> stores it in `_pendingImagePath`, emits `InsertionModalFotoSaving()`, then
  awaits `SavePhotoEntryUseCase(path)`, same failure-mapping shape as audio.
- **`RetryRequested`**: re-dispatches the same saving branch against whichever of
  `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` is non-null for the tab the failure state belongs to — no
  re-recording, no re-picking (FR-009).
- **`ModalClosed`**: calls `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` if a recording is in flight; the
  bloc is then disposed by `BlocProvider` as the sheet closes — nothing further to do (FR-008).
- **What the page does, not the bloc**: on any transition into a "success" condition (handled as a
  one-shot side effect, not a state — see `save-usecases.md`), `InsertionModalPage` is the one that
  calls `Navigator.pop` to close the sheet (FR-011: "the modal closes and return[s] the user to
  Home/Chat with no other visible change"). The bloc's own state never needs a dedicated
  `InsertionModalSuccess` case precisely because there is nothing to render for it — the sheet is
  simply gone.

## Who depends on this

`InsertionModalPage` and its three tab widgets (`TextoTabView`, `AudioTabView`, `FotoTabView`) —
each renders only the sub-states relevant to its own tab via `state is InsertionModal<Tab>*`
pattern matching, the same exhaustive-`switch` convention `VaultBloc`/`VaultPage` already use. The
waveform widget additionally reads `AudioCaptureRepository.amplitudeStream` via `get_it` directly
(the one sanctioned bypass of "always through the bloc," justified in
contracts/audio-capture-repository.md).

## R11 — Why this unit's own failure/retry UI is allowed to look different from the prototype's named "Erro" states

- **Decision**: The audio/photo failure UI this unit builds (FR-009) is a plain message plus one
  generic retry action, styled from existing tokens (`colorError` text, a ghost/outline button) —
  it does **not** reproduce the prototype's specific "Áudio — Erro" / "Foto — Erro" component specs
  verbatim (prototype-extract.md §2.3: the red warning icon treatment, the exact copy "Não foi
  possível transcrever"/"Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", the specific outline button styled
  as that named state, or Foto-Erro's second action "Salvar só a foto").
- **Rationale**: This looks, at first glance, like an RNF08 violation ("every screen MUST be
  faithful to the prototype") — but RNF08's fidelity obligation applies to states this unit actually
  implements. The "Erro" states as named in the prototype are explicitly, by spec.md's own
  Clarification 1, RF02's screens to build ("this unit MUST NOT present... a dedicated multi-state
  screen... or modality-specific retry affordances such as 'Tentar novamente' or 'Salvar só a
  foto'" — FR-007). FR-009 still requires *some* failure-and-retry behavior to exist for this unit's
  own narrower pipeline (transcription-or-save failing), so this unit necessarily renders its own,
  undocumented-by-the-prototype failure view — one the spec's Clarification already pre-approved as
  not needing to match RF02's specific look. This is not a new judgment call; it is carrying the
  spec's own already-resolved Clarification 1 through to its concrete UI consequence, called out
  here so a later reviewer does not mistake the deliberately plainer failure view for an
  overlooked fidelity gap.
- **Alternatives considered**: Reusing the prototype's exact "Erro" copy/iconography now and simply
  omitting the "Tentar novamente"/"Salvar só a foto" *buttons* — rejected: the copy and icon
  treatment are as much a part of the named, RF02-reserved state as its buttons are; partially
  borrowing its look while structurally not being that state would be a confusing hybrid, not a
  faithful implementation of either unit's scope.

## R12 — Correction: the "Áudio" tab has its own idle state, it does not auto-start recording

- **Decision**: FR-004 and this unit's implementation are corrected so the "Áudio" tab opens on an
  idle state — a round start control with the caption "Toque para gravar" — and only requests
  microphone permission and starts real-time recording once the user taps that control. The
  previous reading (recording starts the instant the tab becomes active) is wrong and is removed.
- **Rationale**: prototype-extract.md §2.3's summary table for this screen lists only "Gravando",
  "Processando", "Transcrito", "Erro" for Áudio, with no idle/start row, which is what led the
  original spec to assume (spec.md's since-corrected Assumptions bullet) that "Gravando" was this
  tab's default state. Direct inspection of the prototype's Tela 2 on a device shows an idle state
  with a round start button precedes "Gravando" — the extract's table omitted it. `docs/input/` is
  frozen and is not edited to reflect this (Constitution Principle I); this unit's own spec and
  implementation are corrected instead, since RNF08's fidelity obligation is to the actual
  prototype, not to a summary table that under-documented one of its states.
- **Alternatives considered**: Leaving FR-004 as "starts recording immediately" and treating the
  idle state as an extension — rejected: auto-starting the microphone without an explicit user tap
  is also the wrong UX default for a sensitive permission like audio recording, independent of the
  prototype question, and the correction's own report confirms no part of FR-004's existing scope
  (stop control, waveform, timer) is affected other than what precedes "Gravando."

### Story 2 — Audio entry (P1)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Áudio". **Expect**: recording starts immediately (no extra tap) — stop

   no entry created, a plain failure message, and a retry action that re-attempts without asking to
   re-record (FR-009/SC-004) — confirm by restoring connectivity and tapping retry, which succeeds
   using the same already-recorded audio.

### Story 3 — Photo entry (P2)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Foto". **Expect**: two buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria", no image yet.
2. Tap "Galeria", pick `ocr_fixture_01.png` (or any image with legible text) from the Simulator's

   R11), with a retry action that re-attempts OCR on the same already-picked image.
5. Tap "Câmera" instead and cancel the system camera UI without taking a photo. **Expect**: stays
   on the two-button Captura state, no entry created.

### Story 4 — Abandoning a capture (P3)

   no entry created, no leftover audio file persisted as an entry.

   Cases); Foto shows its normal two-button Captura state, not an error about audio.
4. Open the Foto tab, tap "Galeria", cancel the picker. **Expect**: no entry created.

# Quickstart: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

How to validate this unit end-to-end once implemented, mapped to spec.md's four user stories. A
run guide, not an implementation spec — interfaces are in `contracts/`, state/entities in
`data-model.md`.

## Prerequisites

- F000 and RF03 already implemented and passing (`specs/001-foundation/`,
  `specs/002-biometric-auth-vault/`) — this unit builds on their `ApiClient`/`Failure`/routing/DI
  and reaches Home/Chat the same way those units' quickstarts do (sign up or log in, pass the
  vault).
- `fvm flutter pub get` after `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, `connectivity_plus`, and
  `path_provider` are added to `pubspec.yaml` (research.md R1–R5).
- `ios/Runner/Info.plist` contains `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`, and
  `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` (research.md R1/R3) — without these, the first attempt to
  record or pick an image crashes immediately on-device/Simulator rather than merely failing.
- `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` raised to `15.6` in all three `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`
  configurations (research.md R2 — `whisper_ggml`'s documented minimum).
- The bundled Whisper `tiny` model asset is present under the project's assets and declared in
  `pubspec.yaml` (research.md R2) — without it, the first audio Save hangs or errors on the
  one-time model copy step rather than transcribing.
- A `.env` with valid `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`/`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` — every Save (all three modalities)
  calls the backend at least once (`entries-create`; audio/photo also call `media-ocr` for photo,
  or only `entries-create` for audio since transcription itself is local).
- The backend fixtures are useful for manual verification:
  `docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav` (expected transcript in
  `expected-transcription.md`), `media/ocr_fixture_01.png` (legible text), `media/ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png`
  (illegible — exercises the no-usable-text Edge Case).

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                    # RNF06 import-shape lint (always_use_package_imports)
fvm flutter test --coverage
lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/**/domain/**' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain-html   # RNF07 gate — now including lib/features/entries/domain, lib/features/capture/domain
```

Key domain tests this unit's coverage depends on (contracts/*.md):
- `SaveTextEntryUseCase`/`SaveAudioEntryUseCase`/`SavePhotoEntryUseCase` against fake repositories:
  offline short-circuit, recognition failure, empty-result, entry-creation failure, and the happy
  path, for each modality.
- `EntriesRepositoryImpl`: the 3 failure scenarios (timeout/offline/malformed) for `entries-create`,
  plus the cache-append-on-success behavior.
- `PhotoRecognitionRepositoryImpl`: the same 3 scenarios for `media-ocr`, plus `OCR_NO_TEXT` and
  the client-side empty-text guard (contracts/photo-capture-repository.md).
- `AudioTranscriptionRepositoryImpl`/its fake: empty/whitespace transcript -> `EmptyRecognitionResult`.
- `InsertionModalBloc`: tab-switch resets, mid-recording tab-switch discard, double-tap-save
  ignored while already saving, retry re-using the held file path without a fresh
  recording/picker call.

## Manual verification (device/Simulator — `record`/`image_picker`/`whisper_ggml` have no platform
channel under `flutter_test`)

### Story 1 — Text entry (P1)

1. From Home/Chat, tap "+". **Expect**: the modal rises as an overlay (Home/Chat visible/dimmed
   underneath), Texto tab active, empty field, "Salvar" disabled.
2. Type a short note. **Expect**: "Salvar" becomes enabled the moment the field is non-empty.
3. Tap "Salvar". **Expect**: a brief plain loading indicator if the call takes >300 ms (RNF01),
   then the modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change (FR-011).
4. Confirm via a debug log of the request (or a backend-side check) that `POST entries-create` was
   called with `source: "manual"` and the typed content.

### Story 2 — Audio entry (P1)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Áudio". **Expect**: recording starts immediately (no extra tap) — stop
   button, animated waveform, running `mm:ss` timer.
2. Speak a short phrase, tap stop. **Expect**: a plain loading indicator (not a styled
   "Transcrevendo..." screen, not an editable-text review step — FR-007), then the modal closes.
3. Confirm the created entry's content matches what was said and `source: "audio"`.
4. Repeat using `audio_fixture_01.wav` played into the Simulator's mic (or injected directly into
   `AudioCaptureRepository` in a debug harness) and compare the resulting entry's content against
   `expected-transcription.md`.
5. **Failure path**: force a network failure (airplane mode) after stopping a recording. **Expect**:
   no entry created, a plain failure message, and a retry action that re-attempts without asking to
   re-record (FR-009/SC-004) — confirm by restoring connectivity and tapping retry, which succeeds
   using the same already-recorded audio.

### Story 3 — Photo entry (P2)

1. Tap "+", switch to "Foto". **Expect**: two buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria", no image yet.
2. Tap "Galeria", pick `ocr_fixture_01.png` (or any image with legible text) from the Simulator's
   photo library (seed it via `xcrun simctl addmedia` beforehand if needed). **Expect**: a plain
   loading indicator, then the modal closes.
3. Confirm the created entry's content is the image's recognized text and `source: "photo"`.
4. Repeat with `ocr_fixture_ilegivel.png`. **Expect**: no entry created, a plain failure message
   (not the prototype's styled "Foto — Erro" screen, and no "Salvar só a foto" action — research.md
   R11), with a retry action that re-attempts OCR on the same already-picked image.
5. Tap "Câmera" instead and cancel the system camera UI without taking a photo. **Expect**: stays
   on the two-button Captura state, no entry created.

### Story 4 — Abandoning a capture (P3)

1. Type partial text in Texto, tap the modal's close ("x"). **Expect**: no entry created.
2. Switch to Áudio (recording auto-starts), then close the modal before tapping stop. **Expect**:
   no entry created, no leftover audio file persisted as an entry.
3. Start a recording, switch to Foto mid-recording. **Expect**: the recording is discarded (Edge
   Cases); Foto shows its normal two-button Captura state, not an error about audio.
4. Open the Foto tab, tap "Galeria", cancel the picker. **Expect**: no entry created.

### Edge cases worth exercising manually at least once

- Deny microphone permission at the OS level (Simulator: Settings → Privacy → Microphone → off for
  the app), then open the Áudio tab. **Expect**: an explanatory message in place of the recording
  controls, no crash.
- Deny camera permission, tap "Câmera". **Expect**: an explanatory message, no crash; "Galeria"
  still works independently.
- Turn on airplane mode, open the Texto tab, type something, tap "Salvar". **Expect**: blocked
  immediately with a clear message — confirm via a network log that no `entries-create` call was
  even attempted (FR-010/SC-005), not just that it failed.
- Double-tap "Salvar" quickly on a slow connection. **Expect**: exactly one entry is created, not
  two.
- Background the app mid-recording (Simulator: Cmd+Shift+H), then relaunch. **Expect**: cold launch
  re-enters the app's normal routing (splash → vault → Home/Chat); the modal is not reopened in any
  partially-recorded state — nothing was persisted.

5. Tap "Câmera" instead and cancel the system camera UI without taking a photo. **Expect**: stays
   on the two-button Captura state, no entry created.

### Story 4 — Abandoning a capture (P3)

1. Type partial text in Texto, tap the modal's close ("x"). **Expect**: no entry created.
2. Switch to Áudio, tap the start control to begin recording, then close the modal before tapping
   stop. **Expect**: no entry created, no leftover audio file persisted as an entry.
3. Start a recording, switch to Foto mid-recording. **Expect**: the recording is discarded (Edge
   Cases); Foto shows its normal two-button Captura state, not an error about audio.
4. Open the Foto tab, tap "Galeria", cancel the picker. **Expect**: no entry created.

- Deny microphone permission at the OS level (Simulator: Settings → Privacy → Microphone → off for

  controls, no crash.

  still works independently.
- Turn on airplane mode, open the Texto tab, type something, tap "Salvar". **Expect**: blocked
  immediately with a clear message — confirm via a network log that no `entries-create` call was
  even attempted (FR-010/SC-005), not just that it failed.
- Double-tap "Salvar" quickly on a slow connection. **Expect**: exactly one entry is created, not
  two.
- Background the app mid-recording (Simulator: Cmd+Shift+H), then relaunch. **Expect**: cold launch
  re-enters the app's normal routing (splash → vault → Home/Chat); the modal is not reopened in any
  partially-recorded state — nothing was persisted.

A user prefers to speak rather than type. They tap "+", switch to the "Áudio" tab, and recording begins with a visible waveform and timer. They tap stop, and after a brief moment the spoken content is saved as a journal entry just like a written one.

**Why this priority**: Voice capture is one of the two microphone/camera-dependent paths and, together with Story 1, establishes that every modality converges on the same entry format — the central acceptance criterion of this unit.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Áudio tab, recording a short spoken note, stopping the recording, confirming Save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "audio" and text content derived from what was spoken.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Áudio" tab, **Then** recording starts immediately, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running mm:ss timer.
2. **Given** an active recording, **When** the user taps stop, **Then** the recording ends and the system automatically transcribes it and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "audio" and the transcribed text as its content.
3. **Given** a completed audio capture that is being transcribed and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
4. **Given** transcription or the save itself fails (e.g., inaudible recording, network timeout), **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to re-record, as long as the captured audio is still held locally.

Clean. Here's a summary of the fix.

**Root cause:** [insertion_modal_bloc.dart](lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_bloc.dart) had no idle state for the Áudio tab at all — `TabSelected(audio)` went straight into `_startAudioTab`, which checked mic permission and called `AudioCaptureRepository.start()` synchronously on tab entry. This matched the original spec's FR-004 and its "Assumptions" section, but that assumption traced back to the prototype extract's summary table (`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §2.3), which only listed "Gravando/Processando/Transcrito/Erro" for Áudio and never captured an idle/start sub-state — a transcription gap, not something in the real prototype's Tela 2.

**Code changes:**
- Added `InsertionModalAudioIdle` state and `AudioStartRequested` event.
- `TabSelected(audio)` now emits `InsertionModalAudioIdle()` only — no permission check, no recording.
- New `_onAudioStartRequested` handler (only acts from the idle state) does the permission check → `AudioCaptureRepository.start()` → `InsertionModalAudioRecording` that `_startAudioTab` used to do.
- [audio_tab_view.dart](lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/audio_tab_view.dart) renders the idle state as a round mic button + "Toque para gravar" caption, mirroring the app's existing "Toque para desbloquear" biometric-unlock pattern (`vault_page.dart`) for visual consistency, and dispatches `AudioStartRequested` on tap.
- Updated bloc tests: split the old single "TabSelected(audio)" tests into idle-on-tab-select, start-with-permission-denied, start-with-permission-granted, and a guard test for `AudioStartRequested` outside idle.

**PRD/spec corrected** (flagged `prd` in your ticket) since `docs/input/` is frozen and can't be edited per this repo's constitution: updated `spec.md` (FR-004, the Story 2 narrative/acceptance scenario, and the Assumptions bullet), `data-model.md`'s state-transition pseudocode, `contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md`, `quickstart.md`'s manual test steps, and added `research.md` R12 explaining the correction and why the frozen extract wasn't touched.
